body:
Join us at Southbank Centre, from Friday 11th September to Sunday the 13th. Future Inventions will be exhibiting 3 works at the centre's first ever creative technology festival, Creative Intelligence. We made a book, a game, and a mural.



### Future Inventions @ Creative Intelligence, Southbank Centre

When: Friday September 11th - Sunday September 13th

What: A three-day takeover packed with art, performance, music, free demos, debate, play and experimentation. Explore how artists and digital innovation are reshaping the world we live in at London's newest celebration of art, imagination and technology.

Where: Queen Elizabeth Hall, Southbank Centre

We are so excited to be showing new work, alongside other London creative tech communities such as Identity2.0, London Laptop Community Orchestra, AlgoRhythms and so many more. There'll be drop-in workshops, performances, and interactive artworks. On our end, we're creating a temporary library and learning corner installation including:

* \[A Game] Shapeshifters

An interactive work that moves with you, mimicking how dance is both innate knowledge and transmitted through gathering/learning from one another

* \[A Mural] Networked relationships: An Alternative History of Communication Technology

A genealogy of community-owned communication infrastructures, tracing how Black, anti-colonial and grassroots traditions have imagined connection as a shared cultural practice.

* \[A Book] Imagination As Protocol: A Community Technology Guide
title: ⭐ Future Inventions @ Southbank Centre ⭐
